evidence.excerpt: Bogićević has conducted on-site data collection and consulting engagements at four electronics contract manufacturers in Serbia and one in Hungary, accumulating practical familiarity with SMT lines, AOI and ICT systems, and the quality management constraints typical of regional SMEs. He has delivered internal training on quality cost measurement for quality engineers at two partner companies.
